description: Records time the person worked: the day, hours, the customer (by its exact name, or id), optionally the project (code) and the service (name) it was for, a rate when the service has none, a note, and whether it is billable. It is the person's own time. Nothing is posted or billed; the person bills it later from Mobile Accounting (or with bill_time).

billable.description: false for internal, non-billable time (no customer needed). Default true.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

customer.description: The customer, by its exact name as in find_contacts.

project.description: A project code of the books (optional).

rate.description: The hourly rate, when the service has none.

service.description: A service name of the books (optional; its rate applies).

name: log_time
title: Log time
